pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal dark regions with blurred, low-frequency pixel gradients at the edges. Patch area is visibly larger on the mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometries on the visible portion of the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological network. Junction nodes are identifiable where multiple pathways converge between patches, although pixel thickness and continuity are degraded by motion blur and low resolution.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized, dark, and irregularly shaped textural disruption is visible on the dorsal ridge at the junction of the neck and shoulder.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark, protruding mass is present on the upper dorsal line at the base of the neck, representing a distinct structural anomaly relative to the surrounding mane and pelage.
